profile_text.body:
Asana is a publicly traded work and project management software company (NYSE: ASAN, CIK 0001477720) that describes itself as providing work management software for teams and AI agents, with tools to plan, automate, and execute workflows. Its platform is aimed at what the company calls human-agent teams, meaning human workers and AI agents operating together inside shared workflows.

The company's AI product, Asana AI, sits within the notes, knowledge, and meetings category and covers goal tracking, team productivity analytics, and data residency options. The site describes a concept called the Work Graph, which provides context and memory to AI agents so they can carry forward completed tasks, feedback, and preferences across workflows. The platform bundles several components under the label Agentic Work Management, including AI Teammates, AI Studio, Asana Dash, and MCP and AI Connectors. Users can deploy pre-built AI agents or build custom ones from their team's existing workflows.

The held facts show no litigation on record for Asana, and no MCP server registry presence has been noted separately, though MCP connectors are referenced as part of the product suite described on the company's own site.
